en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a cobblestoned square with a prominent historic town hall building (Rathaus) in the center. The facade has tall arched windows, four white columns, and decorative towers or turrets along the roofline. Flanking the square are older multi‑story buildings and small shops. Printed captions in German appear below the image and along the left edge.
